outcome: Mode of feeding at NICU discharge
Mode of feeding at home after NICU discharge
cohort: 100 mothers of preterm infants born between 2009 and 2010 in Athens, Greece
finding: Breastfeeding at home after NICU discharge was significantly associated with mother's support for maintaining lactation, past experience of breastfeeding, and increased duration of pregnancy.
mod_finding: 70% of the mothers gave birth by caesarean section.
